subject: Welcome starter grant + engagement plan for Olive Analytics
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: starter grant + 14-day extension for Olive Analytics

Hi Marissa / Aditya —

Olive Analytics (signed up 2026-07-28) is a mid-size analytics startup that hit our PLG signup window but has very low token usage so far: ~1.2k tokens consumed of the 100k starter bundle. I attached a quick usage export and the signup profile.

Request: approve a self-serve starter grant of $500 equivalent in credits + a 14-day trial extension to help them complete an initial integration. Proposal notes:
- Credits restricted to inference on "redwood-small" family
- Expiry: 30 days from issuance
- No SLA/discount commitments — purely promotional

Goal: surface them to our sample prompts/templates, get them to send the first 10k tokens so we can trigger product-led expansion. I recommend we include a 20-min onboarding session invite and a short "getting started" doc.

Attachments: olive_usage_q2.csv, signup_profile.pdf

Thanks —
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Growth Lead, Americas
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: starter grant + 14-day extension for Olive Analytics

Thanks for the context, Neha — sounds reasonable. Approve the promo with a couple of guardrails:
- $500 starter grant (tokens only)
- Limit model family to "redwood-small" and opt-in to batching quotas to keep costs predictable
- Expiry 30 days from issue date (no renewals without CSM review)

Please issue via the self-serve credits portal and send the activation email to the customer + CC Aditya so CS can jump on the call. Include the onboarding doc and a brief checklist (install SDK, test prompt, check quotas).

Marissa
VP, Growth & Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Ellis <sam@oliveanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome — starter grant + next steps (Olive Analytics)

Hi Sam —

Congrats on signing up and welcome to Redwood. We noticed your org hasn't ramped yet and we'd love to help you get to the first integration milestone. We've approved a starter grant for Olive Analytics:

- What: $500 worth of inference credits (applied to your account)
- Where: usable on the "redwood-small" family only
- When: credits expire 30 days after issuance
- How to claim: click the link below to accept and activate the credits (self-serve)

Activation link: https://app.redwood.ai/credits/issue/OLIVE-2026-07
Docs & checklist: trial_terms.pdf; getting-started.md (attached)

Optional: we can run a 20-min onboarding session to walk your engineers through the SDK, prefix caching, and a quick prompt test. If that helps, reply with a few times that work and Aditya (CC'd) will schedule.

No action required from your side if you prefer to self-serve — the link will apply the credits automatically to your project. Looking forward to seeing what you build.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Growth Lead, Americas
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Ellis <sam@oliveanalytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Heather Chang <heather@oliveanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Welcome — starter grant + next steps (Olive Analytics)

Hi Neha —

Thanks for this and for the credits — much appreciated. We're still in initial exploration; our engineers hit a few questions around KV cache integration and streaming responses. A quick onboarding call would be great.

Available windows this week: Wed 08/06 between 10:00–12:00 ET or Thu 08/07 14:00–16:00 ET. Let me know what works.

—Sam
Sam Ellis
Head of Platform Engineering
Olive Analytics

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Ellis <sam@oliveanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Welcome — starter grant + next steps (Olive Analytics)

Perfect — locking in Wed 08/06 at 10:30 ET for a 20-min session. Aditya will cover SDK integration and KV cache best practices. Agenda:
- 0–5m: quick intros + use case recap
- 5–15m: SDK demo (auth, streaming, prefix cache)
- 15–20m: next steps + recommended prompt set

Meeting invite sent. I've also attached a short checklist to make the call efficient. If anything changes, shout here.

Neha

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Ellis <sam@oliveanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check-in after onboarding — usage and next steps

Hi Sam —

Quick follow-up after last week's call. Your account has used ~9.8k tokens since the session (great first test), and the starter grant is live. A couple of suggested next steps to keep momentum:

- Run the integration test in getting-started.md (step 3 will validate streaming)
- Send a few real prompts from staging to reach 10–25k tokens — that usually surfaces any config issues
- If you'd like, we can open a short evaluation to test a quantized variant to reduce cost per token on larger volumes

If helpful, here are two quick slots later this week for a follow-up: Thu 08/13 11:00 ET or Fri 08/14 09:30 ET. Otherwise I can check back in two weeks.

Thanks —
Neha

Attachments referenced: trial_terms.pdf, getting-started.md
body_preview: Approve $500 starter grant for Olive Analytics; issue via self-serve link and schedule 20-min onboarding with Aditya to improve activation.
